import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    B = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    pq = []
    e = 0
    o = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        ele = arr[i]
        if ele % 2 == 0:
            e += 1
        else:
            o += 1
        if e == o:
            heapq.heappush(pq, abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))
    ans = 0
    while B >= 0 and pq:
        cost = heapq.heappop(pq)
        B -= cost
        if B < 0:
            break
        ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
